user.title: GEN24 Energy Control
user.description: Configure conservative Home Assistant orchestration for Fronius GEN24 battery policy.

data_description.solar_forecast_sensors: Like the Solar Forecast Card: one ordered daily list. Select at least 2 and at most 7 sensors: today, tomorrow, day 3, day 4, day 5, day 6, day 7. Each sensor must expose a daily kWh forecast as its state.
data_description.pv_production_today_sensor: Actual PV energy produced today in kWh. The integration calculates remaining today = forecast today - production today.

error.forecast_entities_too_few: Select at least two forecast entities: today and tomorrow.
error.forecast_entities_too_many: Select at most seven forecast entities: today through day 7.
